project_type: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite SPA, no backend
build_system: Vite 4 + tsc. Build: `npm run build` (runs tsc then vite build). TypeScript check: `npx tsc --noEmit`
test_framework: Vitest 0.34 with jsdom. Test command: `npm test` (vitest --run). 14 tests in src/utils/billing.test.ts, all must stay passing.
verification_instructions: 1. `npm test` — all 14 billing tests must pass. 2. `npx tsc --noEmit` — zero errors. 3. `npm run build` — must succeed with no errors.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell — use semicolons not && for command chaining. No new npm packages allowed. No backend/auth/paid APIs. All localStorage ops must be wrapped in try/catch (storage.ts helpers already do this).
contribution_requirements: Use formatINR() from src/utils/currency.ts for all monetary display. Use Logo component from src/components/Logo.tsx in all page headers. Use inline hex colors in Tailwind (e.g. bg-[#0f2744]) not custom class names. No hardcoded $ or ₹ in display strings. Keep all 14 billing tests passing.
key_patterns: Components use inline hex colors (#0f2744, #2d7d46, #34d399) in Tailwind arbitrary value syntax. BillBreakdown and ConsumptionInput types come from billing.ts. TariffPlan comes from data/tariffs.ts. localStorage via storage.ts safeGet/safeSet helpers. Recharts used for charts (LineChart, BarChart). No Recharts on landing page. PDF via jspdf in pdfReport.ts. Tailwind custom tokens: navy, sage, navy.light, navy.dark, sage.pale — BUT plan says to use inline hex instead of these tokens.
directory_structure: src/pages/ — 3 pages (LandingPage, CalculatorPage, ApplianceCalculator). src/components/ — 12 components. src/utils/ — billing.ts (pure calc engine + 14 tests), currency.ts (formatINR, formatNumberINR, parseINR), storage.ts (localStorage helpers with safeGet/safeSet), applianceCalculator.ts, pdfReport.ts. src/data/tariffs.ts — 3 demo TariffPlan objects. Router.tsx — BrowserRouter with 3 routes. index.css — minimal (only @tailwind directives). tailwind.config.js — extends with navy/sage color tokens.
